# 💳 Doc from Template (gws CLI)

💳 Requires a paid Google Workspace account for the gws CLI — no free tier. Curated by Skill Harbor — a step-by-step recipe that copies a Google Docs template, writes content into the new copy (`gws docs +write`), and shares it with the team (`gws drive permissions create`). Distinct from the sibling recipe share-doc-and-notify: that one shares an existing document with edit access and sends a notification; this one builds a fresh document from a template first. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: the recipe assumes the gws-drive and gws-docs utility skills are loaded and the gws binary is installed and authenticated; you need the template document's ID and the collaborators' email addresses up front. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
